title: Toggling makes parity odd
statement: Let $w$ be a length-$n$ Boolean string and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. If $w$ has even Hamming weight, then the string obtained by toggling its bit at coordinate $i$ has odd Hamming weight.
hypotheses_covered: $w$ is a Boolean string on $n$ coordinates
